name: Kimi to Koi ni Ochiru Toki
source:
Private school that integrates education from kindergarten to university.  
Educational practitioner Chisato Hirose came to the school around the end of January from the new term. 
For some of his class students it is the name impossible to forget... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一所从幼儿园到大学实行一贯制教育的私立学校。
新学期一月底左右，教育实习生广濑千里来到这里。
对班上的某些学生而言，这是一个永远无法忘记的名字…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
